Re: USAID - Google Meeting Follow-up
[contact omitted] Kenneth Zoeller Tuesday, June 14, 2022 at 8:44:48 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Ria Strasser-Galvis [opaque block]
Cc: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Alden Hartopo, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Alexandria Walden, [contact omitted] Amy Malessa,
[contact omitted] Avinash Kaza, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Brionne Dawson, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Clement Wolf,
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Josh Blumenteld, [contact omitted] Joshua Machleder, [contact omitted] John O'Bryan,
[contact omitted] Lorri Anne Meils, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Melike Yetken Krilla, [contact omitted] Sabeen Dhanani,
[contact omitted] Shannon Maguire
Hi Ria,
Ihope you're having a great week! We wanted to follow up with you on a few items.
• Amy has been hearing from colleagues in the field about a few local partners having issues with their
Google/YouTube accounts. Are you able to provide guidance on the best point of contact for these
kinds of issues?
• We may have some other emerging issues/questions as well related to some of the questions
we asked in our follow-up document after our meeting last month.
• You had asked that we reach out around now to start the discussion on training for staff at USAID
Missions to help raise awareness about different types of in-kind assistance provided by Google.
• We'd like to set up a meeting with the team at Google News to discuss unlocking ad revenue for
Ukrainian, Moldovan, Belarussian, and Russian newsrooms as well as broader global collaboration
around the Summit for Democracy.
Thank you for considering these questions. I'd note that the first bullet is considered somewhat urgent by
the field - any advice would be greatly appreciated and we can follow up with more details.
Very best,
Kenny
On Fri, May 13, 2022 at 2:43 PM Ria Strasser-Galvis - [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Kenny and team,
It was great to talk to you all and thank you for the list of your disinfo research partners. I will work on getting you
answers to the follow up questions and revert back when complete in a week or so. Let's touch base in mid-June
regarding setting up a briefing for missions.
On Wed, May 11, 2022 at 10:04 AM Kenneth Zoeller <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi all,
Thank you for your time last Friday. We appreciated the opportunity to hear from you about Google's work across
several important topics. We are also grateful for Google's response to this crisis through your critical funding and
in-kind support for humanitarian organizations.
As discussed during the call, we have assembled a list of follow-up questions in the attached document.
Additionally, I have attached a list of potential partners for you to consider for dis/misinformation research projects,
Trusted Flagger Program, and any reports of problematic content / behavior -- each of these is a USAID partner.
Finally, l've also included a list of next steps for us to take forward. Most of these are on USAID to initiate.
• Google to respond to the questions in the attached document.
